Sol.name: Sol
Sol.description: The cradle of humanity. Earth's oceans glitter beneath a crowd of orbital docks, and every trade route seems to start here.

Proxima Centauri.name: Proxima Centauri
Proxima Centauri.description: The nearest star to Sol, a small red dwarf prone to violent flares. Its stations hug the one temperate world and keep their shields up.

Alpha Centauri.name: Alpha Centauri
Alpha Centauri.description: A bright pair of suns circling each other, the first stop beyond home. Every traveller remembers the double sunrise.

Barnard's Star.name: Barnard's Star
Barnard's Star.description: A swift, faint red dwarf racing across the sky. Prospectors work its cold worlds hoping for a lucky strike.

Wolf 359.name: Wolf 359
Wolf 359.description: A tiny, flickering red dwarf with a bad reputation and worse flares. Only the stubborn stay.

Lalande 21185.name: Lalande 21185
Lalande 21185.description: A bright red dwarf with a famous record in the star catalogues. Surveyors, astronomers and smugglers all like the peace.

Gliese 65.name: Gliese 65
Gliese 65.description: A pair of flare stars that can double their brightness in seconds. Traders time their arrivals carefully.

Sirius.name: Sirius
Sirius.description: The brightest star in the sky, blazing white and bold, with a ghostly white dwarf companion. Traders flock to its glittering docks.

Ross 154.name: Ross 154
Ross 154.description: A flare-prone red dwarf keeps pilots watching their shields. Failed harvests have the farmers eyeing every passing freighter. Noble houses hold the stations and guard their honour jealously.

Ross 248.name: Ross 248
Ross 248.description: A cooling white dwarf, the dead heart of an old star, lights the system. Refineries and assembly yards make this one of the richest industrial hubs. Several governments trade, bicker and spy on one another here.

Ran.name: Ran
Ran.description: A young orange star ringed by dusty belts. Prospectors and pirates both love the cover the debris gives them.

Lacaille 9352.name: Lacaille 9352
Lacaille 9352.description: A dim red dwarf casts a ruddy twilight. Vast orbital factories turn out machinery night and day. A loose league of stations argues its way through each day.

Ross 128.name: Ross 128
Ross 128.description: A faint red sun leaves the system in perpetual dusk. Vast orbital factories turn out machinery night and day. A loose league of stations argues its way through each day.

EZ Aqr.name: EZ Aqr
EZ Aqr.description: A small red star flickers sullenly over the docks. Refineries and assembly yards make this one of the richest industrial hubs. Several governments trade, bicker and spy on one another here.

61 Cygni.name: 61 Cygni
61 Cygni.description: A pair of orange dwarfs, the first star ever to have its distance measured. Surveyors still come here on pilgrimage.

Procyon.name: Procyon
Procyon.description: A bright yellow-white star trailing a faint white dwarf. A sharp, ambitious port town on the edge of the lanes.

Struve 2398.name: Struve 2398
Struve 2398.description: A warm orange sun hangs low over the stations. Smoke-stacked stations and shipyards crowd the orbits. Citizens vote on everything, from tariffs to the docking queue.

Groombridge 34.name: Groombridge 34
Groombridge 34.description: Two red dwarfs on a long, lazy orbit. The sector's lanes meet here and so does its gossip.

Epsilon Indi.name: Epsilon Indi
Epsilon Indi.description: A wandering orange star, trailed by a pair of brown dwarfs. Few lights burn out here, and every dock is glad of visitors.

GJ 1111.name: GJ 1111
GJ 1111.description: A small red star flickers sullenly over the docks. Endless fields stretch beneath the orbital docks. Citizens vote on everything, from tariffs to the docking queue.

Tau Ceti.name: Tau Ceti
Tau Ceti.description: A calm, Sun-like star in a quiet sector, long dreamed of as a second home. Patient settlers have made it one.

Gliese 54.1.name: Gliese 54.1
Gliese 54.1.description: A faint red sun leaves the system in perpetual dusk. Smoke-stacked stations and shipyards crowd the orbits. Shared stores and long queues at the dock office.

Luyten's Star.name: Luyten's Star
Luyten's Star.description: A quiet red dwarf with a handful of temperate worlds. A good place for those who prefer being left alone.

Kapteyn's Star.name: Kapteyn's Star
Kapteyn's Star.description: An ancient red dwarf from the galaxy's old halo, hurtling through at breakneck speed. Settlers here feel like they are always passing through.

Lacaille 8760.name: Lacaille 8760
Lacaille 8760.description: A faint red sun leaves the system in perpetual dusk. Steady industry hums across the system's stations. Rival factions share the system in an uneasy peace.
